name: Vehicle Parts Lifecycle Status
listdetail: The Changed Parts Lookup API provides access to the latest version of parts information updated in the system, filtered by date and accessory family code. This API is essential for tracking the status of vehicle parts during their development lifecycle, allowing users to determine whether parts are still in prototype stages or have entered production. Details include family code, group number, development code, part name, part number, supplier code, plant code, production status, and design staff code. Typical use cases for this API include enabling engineering teams to monitor part development progress, supporting manufacturing planning by verifying production readiness, and assisting quality control in identifying parts currently in use versus those still under development. By providing up-to-date part status information, the API helps streamline communication across design, production, and supply chain teams, ensuring efficient vehicle development and manufacturing processes. To monitor Engineering Change Instructions (ECIs) before a part is finalized for production, please refer to the Engineering Change Instructions Tracking API.

name: Engineering Change Instructions Tracking
listdetail: This API gives users access to the latest Engineering Change Instructions (ECIs) and associated part data, such as material specs, design details, drawings, and supplier information. By querying an ECI or Production Part Release (PPR) number, users can retrieve accurate, current details needed to track and manage engineering changes within the electronic Master Data Management (eMDM) system. Engineering changes can impact part quality, vehicle performance, and manufacturing efficiency. This API helps Toyota purchasing teams and suppliers reduce that risk by providing timely, reliable information. It also supports traceability through access to drawing records, minor code transitions, and historical registration data. To verify that a part is ready for use in vehicle builds, please refer to the Vehicle Parts Lifecycle Status API.

name: Retrieve Active Employee Work Schedule
listdetail: This API, part of the Team Member Rotation Application (TMRA) manufacturing portal, retrieves the active work schedule for plant employees within the manufacturing job process area. It provides detailed information about the employee’s assigned date, shift, job area, and specific work tasks during the defined submission period (the timeframe for which the schedule is valid and applicable). The response also includes the total working minutes allocated on a particular production line and job. This API supports TMRA’s goal of optimizing workforce rotation by providing accurate, timely scheduling data for effective team member assignment and workload management during the submission period.

name: Manufacturing Shift Delivery Information
listdetail: This API, part of the Manufacturing Operations Management (MOM) system, provides SAP and related systems with detailed shift-level production data. It delivers information on all manufacturing jobs performed and delivered during a production shift at a specific plant, including activities like assembly, inspection, and repair. Each job is linked to its cost center, enabling integration with SAP for accurate tracking of labor and material costs. This connection helps reconcile production output with financial data for better budgeting and resource planning. The API also reports plant, shop, and line details, along with process counts and production status, offering granular visibility into manufacturing line performance for operational and financial analysis. This sequence outlines where each API fits within the end-to-end manufacturing process. 1. Manufacturing Sales Order Submission : SAP sends confirmed sales orders to MOM to trigger production planning. 2. Manufacturing Sales Order Acknowledgements : MOM confirms receipt and processing of the sales order to SAP. 3. Goods and Parts Quantity Synchronization : MOM manufactures goods, sends GPQ data - MOM reports the actual quantities of parts produced to SAP for inventory and production tracking. 3A. Manufacturing Shift Delivery Information: Provides SAP and accounting teams with a detailed breakdown of all manufacturing operations completed during a shift. 4. Material Usage Variance : MOM sends actual vs. planned material usage data to SAP for cost and inventory control. 5. Finished Goods Shipment Confirmation : SAP notifies MOM that finished goods have been shipped to customers or distribution centers.

name: Abnormal Logistics Events Monitoring
listdetail: The Abnormal Logistics Events Monitoring is designed to provide real-time tracking and management of abnormal logistics events within the North American Manufacturing Centers (NAMCs). It integrates data from multiple logistics-related systems including Supplier Window Times, Logistics Billing, Job Instructions, and supplier shipping locations through the Logistics Input Output System (LIOS). This API enables users to monitor the status of routes at the plant level by capturing critical event details such as event type, problem type, trailer information, estimated time of arrival (ETA), and current status. By consolidating and processing this data on demand, the API supports the Toyota Logistics Management System Group (TLMSG) in optimizing route timing, frequency, and overall logistics network control. Ultimately, it helps prevent disruptions by providing visibility into abnormal conditions and control points across the supply chain, ensuring smoother logistics operations and improved network reliability. This sequence outlines where each API fits within the end-to-end logistics operations. 1. Supplier Skid and Box Details : Provides detailed planned shipment data (skid/pallet and box level) from Toyota to suppliers and internal systems and sets the foundation by communicating what needs to be shipped, where, and how. 2. Supplier Pallet Build and Load Shipment Confirmation : Suppliers use this API to confirm pallet building and shipment loading based on the planned data received. 3. Logistics Driver Validation and Route Tracking : Validates drivers authorized to perform pickups using invitation codes and provides route details and enables real-time tracking of driver pickup activities, ensuring shipments are collected as planned. 4. Driver Route and Shipment Status : Provides Toyota plants with real-time updates on driver location, order status changes, schedule alerts, and event notifications during shipment transit. This API delivers critical metrics such as mileage, transit time, and efficiency gaps, enabling plants to monitor shipment progress and respond promptly to any disruptions. 5. Abnormal Logistics Events Monitoring: Monitors for any abnormal events or disruptions during shipment transit (e.g., delays, shortages).

name: Dealer Support Material Orders
listdetail: This API provides comprehensive reporting on dealer orders and transactions for support materials. These materials include promotional items, technical manuals, training guides, branded vehicle parts, parts catalogs, and marketing collateral designed to assist dealers in sales, service, and customer support activities. Dealers can purchase these items to enhance their customer offerings, support service operations, and strengthen brand presence. The API captures essential transaction details such as dealer identification, product types, quantities, transaction dates, and status, enabling efficient tracking and management of support material distribution across the dealer network. This sequence outlines end-to-end visibility from order placement through financial reconciliation: 1. The Dealer Support Material Orders API is used first to track and manage the ordering and distribution of support materials by dealers. 2. Once materials are distributed and transactions are completed, the Financial Invoice Posting API is used to post and reconcile the financial invoices related to those distributed materials.

name: Parts Distribution Center Lane Assignment
listdetail: This API is designed to manage and track lane assignments within a Parts Distribution Center (PDC) using the Container Control Tower (CCT) system. It provides detailed information about how containers or parts are routed through specific lanes in the distribution center, facilitating efficient handling and movement of inventory. The API response includes metadata such as the number of lane assignment records returned, a status code and message indicating the success of the request, a unique transaction identifier (GUID), and a timestamp marking when the response was generated. The core of the response is an array of lane assignment items, each representing a specific lane action. This comprehensive data supports real-time visibility and control over container movements within the PDC, ensuring that parts are accurately routed to their next destination, such as dealerships or other facilities.

name: Payment Complement Reporting Tracker
listdetail: This API provides detailed information on payments made by Toyota manufacturing plants in Mexico to their local vendors, ensuring compliance with Mexican tax regulations. In Mexico, companies must validate customer invoices with the tax authority Servicio de Administración Tributaria (SAT) through an authorized certification provider (Proveedor Autorizado de Certificación, PAC). The API integrates with SAP’s Document Reporting and Compliance (DRC) solution and the PAC service via Pegaso, enabling automated transmission and validation of payment complements as XML eDocuments. A payment complement is an official electronic document that records payments related to invoices, providing details such as amounts paid, payment dates, and invoice references to ensure regulatory compliance. Key data provided includes issuer and receiver details, Registro Federal de Contribuyentes (RFC) tax identification number, payment and invoice amounts, currency, payment method, document numbers, company codes, and payment dates, ensuring transparency and regulatory compliance in Mexico’s payment processes. The Supplier Invoice Validation API ensures that supplier invoices are validated and unblocked in SAP before payment, focusing on invoice authenticity and compliance. To reconcile and compare posted invoices between SAP and Ariba, please refer to the Supplier Invoice Reconciliation API.

name: iPlus Core Incentives Data Synchronization
listdetail: This API synchronizes core incentive and program setup data from the legacy on-premise system to the AWS Cloud-based iPlus application. The iPlus platform, used by Toyota Motor North America (TMNA), enables the creation, management, and distribution of vehicle incentive offers across North America through its Program Setup (Offer Initiation) module. By ensuring accurate and consistent synchronization of incentive programs and their associated benefits, this API supports TMNA and its dealers in effectively managing and applying incentives regionally. The API synchronization process typically follows this order: 1. iPlus Core Incentives Data Synchronization API runs first to sync the core incentive program definitions and setup data from the legacy on-premises system to the AWS Cloud iPlus platform. This step ensures that all incentive programs and their configurations are accurately established in the cloud. 2. iPlus Incentive Processing Synchronization API runs next to synchronize transaction-related incentive data, such as incentive processing rules, vehicle configurations, dealer information, and matched incentive transactions. This ensures that incentive calculations and applications are based on the latest program data. 3. The iPlus Vehicle Incentive Challenge Synchronization API runs after these two to synchronize challenge-related data. Since challenges are raised against existing incentive programs and transactions, this API depends on the prior synchronization of core incentive data and transaction processing data. It allows dealers to raise, update, and track challenges related to vehicle incentives, ensuring that any disputes or adjustments are reflected accurately in the cloud system. 4. The iPlus Incentive Deal Review Synchronization API runs after the iPlus Vehicle Incentive Challenge Synchronization API to synchronize dealer-submitted deal review documents. This API routes the data to Toyota Motor North America (TMNA) for validation and approval of vehicle incentive eligibility, ensuring that incentive approvals are accurately reflected and audited in the cloud system.

name: Body Weld Inspection Model
listdetail: The Body Weld Inspection Model is designed to assess the quality of spot welding between the car's body and the rocker panel. Through the use of image processing, this model is able to identify weld quality easier and in less time with less manual intervention. As a result of using the data provided, the quality of the vehicles or units being produced will be improved and scrap will be reduced. Utilizing this information can also improve the maintenance requirements on the robots used to do the welds by identifying if the maintenance is being performed on a timely basis. This model will determine the threshold value for dividing No Good Welds from Good Welds and show better bifurcation (ratio) between the two groups. These values are obtained using logistic regression. To detect the centroid of a weld in an image, Yolov4 Object (how it works - series of division techniques) is used and then an average 1D value is calculated around the centroid. For each individual pixel, the 1D value represents the temperature difference between frames. By comparing the average 1D value of the specified frame to the threshold value, the weld quality can be predicted. Thermal Wave Imaging photos are used as input to the model from Toyota Motor Manufacturing Kentucky (TMMK). The spot weld is captured with a thermal imaging camera for one, two, or three seconds. DCB files are used to store these frames (images). Weld quality is determined by further processing of the DCB files into NumPy files. Using the Toyota Digital Manufacturing platform, the model output is displayed via Poke Yoke with the latest 4 Weld status.

name: Supplier Invoice Validation
listdetail: This API enables seamless validation and unblocking of supplier invoices within the SAP system by integrating with Pegaso’s PAC-validated XML data. Proveedor Autorizado de Certificación (PAC) ensures that invoices comply with legal and tax regulations before they are accepted and processed by businesses and government systems. When Pegaso receives an invoice from a supplier, it sends detailed invoice and shipment information to SAP through this API. SAP uses this data to verify invoice authenticity, unblock validated invoices, and authorize them for payment. This process ensures that only compliant and accurate invoices proceed through payment cycles, reinforcing internal financial controls and reducing manual errors. Key use cases include invoice validation, shipment verification, invoice unblocking, and payment authorization. The API supports accounts payable teams, finance and compliance officers, SAP integrators, and procurement departments by automating invoice processing and maintaining alignment with corporate financial policies. Ultimately, it accelerates payment workflows and enhances accuracy in supplier invoice management. The Payment Complement Reporting Tracker API focuses on reporting and validating payment complements after payments are made, ensuring compliance with Mexican tax authority requirements for payment documentation. To reconcile and compare posted invoices between SAP and Ariba, please refer to the Supplier Invoice Reconciliation API.

Demo vehicles are part of a dealer’s inventory, but they are labeled as Demo to allow the dealer to submit warranty claims for that VIN. For warranty eligibility, vehicles must be sold to a customer before they receive a Date of First Use, but Demo vehicles get a DOFU before they are sold. Dealers use Demo cars for test drives or special sales events, but ultimately sell them as new via the Retail Delivery Report (RDR) process just like any other new vehicle. As part of the Demo processing provided by this API, the odometer reading is provided by the dealer when the vehicle is converted to Demo.

name: Retention Parts Propensity Models
listdetail: Retention Parts Propensity Models are available for batteries, brakes, wipers, tires, and oil. Through these models, it is possible to anticipate which vehicles might need a specific part and to communicate with the customer in a timely manner. This helps optimize marketing, improve customer experience for Parts and Service marketing campaigns, and retain customer loyalty. Email campaigns support email marketing efforts for these parts-related campaigns by predicting which customers are most likely to purchase the respective key retention part. Digital campaigns support Digital marketing efforts for parts-related campaigns which are conducted on various Toyota websites or social media platforms. All the key parts of Propensity Models are utilized by media agencies to derive strategies around audiences generated by these models. The Retention Parts Propensity Models are relevant to all customers who have owned or previously owned a Toyota or Lexus. These models predict a likely outcome at the customer level and can be used for a wide variety of business operations. From millions of existing Toyota customers, these models identify only those who are most likely to require retention parts. Data collected from a broad range of sources is used in all of the models to study patterns and trends. Some of the most important data sources for building these models are Toyota Service History USA, Lexus Service History USA, Customer-Dealer Relationship Data, Vehicle Configuration Data, Direct Parts Specifications and Tracking . Datasets like these are crucial to building hundreds of features for training models. For more details, please contact the Customer Data Science (CUDS) team. These Propensity Models predict how likely it is that a customer will visit a Toyota dealership for these specific retention parts within the next month. Each propensity score is calculated at VIN level and a customer can likely have different scores for each VIN owned. A binary prediction value of 1 means that the VIN/Customer is predicted to purchase the specific retention part within a month, while a binary prediction value of 0 means that the VIN/Customer is not likely to purchase the particular part.

name: Mileage Estimator
listdetail: The Mileage Estimator model estimates miles for each VIN at the end of the current month and the end of the following month. It can also forecast the mileage of each VIN for the next six months. This model allows Parts and Services marketing campaigns to target customers based on their mileages. It can also be used for understanding the average VIN miles at the Regional or National level for each Series Type. Additionally, it assists with In-Market Campaigns by identifying the age of the VIN. Data collected from a broad range of sources is used in all of the models to study patterns and trends. Some of the most important data sources for building these models are Toyota Service History USA, Lexus Service History USA, Customer-Dealer Relationship Data, and Vehicle Configuration Data. Based on historical trends, it takes into account specific Series, Model Year, and time-since-first-use combinations, as well as industry averages, standard grids, and miles driven since recent service visits by VIN. Subcomponents of this feature are comprised of Standard Vehicle Miles Grids that have been combined in various ways. Before returning a final estimate at the VIN level, the Mileage Estimator model often refers to these standard grids and industry averages. With this feature, you can perform advanced backfilling and exponential smoothing, making it extremely reliable. The feature is currently available for all Toyota VINs (including Scions) with a Date Of First Use within the last 15 years. Lexus VINs are not included. Presently, this feature covers approximately 30 million VINs. Standard Vehicle Miles Grid 1 - This grid is built at Make, Series, Model Year, Months Since DOFU, Percentiles (0-100), and studies the last 15 years of service history. This grid has a miles smoothing mechanism across months-since-DOFU and percentiles. Standard Vehicle Miles Grid 2 - This grid is built at Make, Series, Months Since DOFU, Percentiles (0-100) combination, and studies the last 15+ years of service history. This grid does back-filling of miles at different percentiles and months since DOFU. Once the backfilling is complete, a miles smoothing mechanism is applied across months-since-DOFU and percentiles. Additionally, the grid forecasts the future for the next six months.

listdetail: The Get Dealer Year Accounts Retail Market Development (RMD) API retrieves Financial Accounts that are to be utilized by the US dealers (both Toyota & Lexus) to submit their Financial Statement for the current year. This API supports the following distributors: - Toyota Motor North America (TMNA) - Gulf States Toyota (GST) - South East Toyota (SET) The following distributors are not currently included: - Toyota de Puerto Rico (TdPR) - Toyota de Mexico (TMEX) - Toyota Canada Inc. (TCI) - ServCo (Hawaii) If you need access to monthly and Year-to-Date (YTD) financial statements covering the current year and the two previous years, please view the Dealer Accounts API. For financial statements at Business Management month-end including Month-To-Date (MTD) and Year-to-Date (YTD) values, please view the Dealer Financials Retail Market Development API. For retail and wholesale sales, parts and service sales, and labor statistics by monthly and Year-to-Date (YTD) values, please view the Dealer Financials Performance and Capital Metrics API.

name: Dealer Sales Summary
listdetail: This Dealer Sales Summary API provides real-time Sales and Stock information at the Dealer, District, Regional, and National levels based on the request. Information on Total Sales, Passenger Cars, Light Trucks, and Series level sales is available in the USA, Mexico, and Puerto Rico regions. Dealers can view their performance against their targets in real-time instead of the traditional batch reports, avoiding any confusion.

name: Dealer Retail Market Information
listdetail: The Dealer Information Retail Market Development (RMD) API provides details about Toyota and Lexus dealerships in the United States. name: Inline Accessory Post-Production Options
listdetail: By using this API, Private Distributors (PD) can access information about Inline Accessory Post-Production Options to order accessories, by PPO Code, that will be assembled on-site by TMNA plants. The information is useful for budget forecasts and managing parts/accessories orders. You will find Distributor Pricing, Dealer Cost Pricing, and Parts Costs along with the Model and Model Year of the vehicle.

name: Vehicle Retail Delivery Report Information
listdetail: This API displays information that has been transmitted from the Vehicle Retail Delivery Report (RDR) to the National Vehicle System (NVS) reflecting the manufacturer's understanding of current dealer sales and/or inventory. Dealers use this API to process, update, and cancel vehicle and sales information within the vehicle inventory database on the Toyota Motor Sales (TMS) host system. This includes important details such as the Vehicle Identification Number (VIN), Model, Serial Number, Sales Stock Number, Sale Date, Mileage, Sale Code, and associated personnel information like the finance insurance manager, sales person, and buyer. The data supports accurate management of sales transactions and inventory records. If you need configuration and sales information for pre-owned Toyota and Lexus vehicles, please refer to the Pre-Owned Vehicle Sales Inquiry API.

name: Dealer Financials Retail Market Development
listdetail: The Dealer Financials Retail Market Development (RMD) API provides access to detailed financial data submitted by U.S. dealers to Toyota Motor North America (TMNA) at the end of each Business Management month. It delivers both Month-to-Date (MTD) and Year-to-Date (YTD) values for individual financial accounts, giving users a comprehensive view of the dealer’s financial performance. The data includes key financial metrics such as sales figures, profit, parts and service revenues, and labor statistics, all of which are submitted by the dealers to TMNA for reporting and analysis. Additional details include the Dealer Number, Region Code, District Code, and important details about the dealer’s operational status, such as the Effective Date and Termination Date. This API supports the following distributors: - Toyota Motor North America (TMNA) - Gulf States Toyota (GST) - South East Toyota (SET) The following distributors are not currently included: - Toyota de Puerto Rico (TdPR) - Toyota de Mexico (TMEX) - Toyota Canada Inc. (TCI) - ServCo (Hawaii) For retail and wholesale sales, parts and service sales, and labor statistics by monthly and Year-to-Date (YTD) values, please view the Dealer Financials Performance and Capital Metrics API. If you need access to monthly and Year-to-Date (YTD) financial statements covering the current year and the two previous years, please view the Dealer Accounts API. If you need financial statements for the current year, please view the Get Dealer Year Accounts API.

name: Transit Accruals
listdetail: The Transit Accruals API is part of the Payments TTMS product for Toyota Transportation Management System (TTMS). When the corresponding voucher ID is used, this API sends the expense costs (i.e. accruals), if any, of transporting a group of Toyota vehicles from origin to final destination to SAP Record to Report (R2R) for accounting. Users can also track the carrier invoice number, carrier invoice date, shipment date, and arrival date. The service also provides the origin and destination codes.
short_desc: The Accruals Toyota Transportation Management System (TTMS) API provides accrual information for the corresponding Voucher ID.

name: USMCA Parts and Manufacturing
platform: TBDP (IRM, PASA, C360, Q360, IRM-Pricing, etc.)
listdetail: The USMCA (United States, Mexico, Canada Agreement) Parts and Manufacturing Dataset is a comprehensive collection of tables designed to manage and track various aspects of parts usage and manufacturing volumes, both for vehicle and non-vehicle applications. Details include the Suppliers Name, Tariff Codes, USMCA qualifying criteria descriptions, and Parts description. This dataset is crucial for ensuring compliance with the United States-Mexico-Canada Agreement (USMCA) and optimizing manufacturing processes.

listdetail: This API provides real time push notifications of dealer information to the external vendor Integrated Couriers & Logistics (ICL) and a ''transport acknowledgment'' message from ICL to Toyota (TTMS). The notifications to ICL includes dealer to whom the vehicle is sold, dealer to whom the vehicle will be shipped, and the location origin code for the vehicle shipment.
